hooks.command: [ "$CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE" = true ] || exit 0; [ -x "$HOME/.local/share/vite-plus/bin/vp" ] || curl -fsSL https://vite.plus | bash >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 1; . "$HOME/.config/vite-plus/env" && vp env on >/dev/null && { [ -z "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] || echo ". \"$HOME/.config/vite-plus/env\"" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; } && cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && vp install --frozen-lockfile --silent && vp env current | grep -E '^ +(Version|Source|Mode)' | head -3
